name: Fondo de Conservación Marina (Costa Rica por Siempre)
summary: Numbered competitive calls for individuals and legal entities to carry out marine-coastal conservation projects in Costa Rica's conservation areas, such as coral restoration, nesting beach monitoring, fisheries management and rat eradication, lasting 12 to 21 months.

calls.label: Call No. 14
